item.title: Gen Z is betting on AI skills to boost earning power
item.description: As AI reshapes entry-level work, young workers are using the technology to boost productivity, build portfolios and pursue new careers.
item.dc:creator: Hani Richter
item.content:encoded: Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft, says that being AI literate is one of the most important skills to leverage for her earning power. “The number of things and tasks that I can do, and the speed that I can do it at, ultimately increases and raises the way that I can create value to other people, to shareholders,” says the New York-based entrepreneur, whose fintech startup quantifAI helps users build and test trustworthy machine learning models. Antaya learned the basics of AI at university, where she studied mathematics and computer science. She started utilizing large language models like ChatGPT as soon as they came out, using it to predict Formula 1 races or forecast which team would win the Premier League. Antaya’s biggest use case, however, was for coding. After graduating in 2023, Antaya applied for dozens of jobs in the tech industry — including management, software engineering, and design roles — before landing an internship at Microsoft, where she worked on voice features and later built evaluation frameworks and tools for AI voice models. Now, she develops AI-focused products and shares how she created them online with her followers — skills that she says carry more value than credentials alone. “If you have an actual receipt of what you built and you're able to publish it online, other people are able to see it as useful proof,” she says. “That goes way further than any sort of little badge.” Antaya now uses AI to schedule tasks, draft replies to every single email in her inbox, analyze large volumes of data or gather webinar analytics from Zoom. Knowing how to use the technology will make you indispensable, she says. “That's what I did. And it has honestly led me to so many more opportunities than I could have ever imagined.” The Wider Trend Compared to older generations, young people tend to be more excited about the impact AI will have on their careers. A 2025 PwC survey of more than 2,000 young workers across the UK found that 67% of Gen Z expect AI to increase their productivity, while nearly half expect it to increase their salary and job security. Mariana Antaya, a 25-year-old former product manager at Microsoft. Courtesy Ivan Mrsic Creative Studio/Handout via REUTERS Matthew Chancey, a certified financial planner and founder of Tax Alpha Companies, says free AI training can offer significant value. “Material that used to sit behind a tuition wall is now free, often published by the companies building the tools,” he says. When evaluating a course, Chancey recommends checking who created it, whether it’s current and, crucially, whether it results in a finished project rather than just a quiz. For those who decide to pay for training, Chancey recommends checking first whether your employer will cover the cost, noting that many employers offer these benefits, though workers seldom take advantage of them. Key Takeaways Invest time before spending money. AI upskilling can be a long-term career investment, with time often proving more valuable than tuition fees. Check whether your employer offers training support or educational benefits. Prioritize projects over certificates. Hands-on projects that improve workflows can carry more weight with employers. Turn higher earnings into long-term security. If AI helps boost your income, consider saving or investing the extra earnings before increasing your spending. Building an emergency fund, paying down debt, and contributing towards retirement can strengthen your financial position over time. Have a money lesson or story to share? Tell us what worked for you — or what didn’t — by emailing hani.richter@tr.com .

item.title: Japón dice que Trump mostró preocupación por debilidad del yen en cumbre con primera ministra Takaichi
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen en una cumbre con la primera ministra japonesa, Sanae Takaichi, según dijo el viernes la ministra de Hacienda Satsuki Katayama, quien ofreció un relato inusualmente detallado de las conversaciones entre ambos líderes sobre las divisas.
item.dc:creator: Makiko Yamazaki
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen en una cumbre con la primera ministra japonesa, Sanae Takaichi, según dijo el viernes la ministra de Hacienda Satsuki Katayama, quien ofreció un relato inusualmente detallado de las conversaciones entre ambos líderes sobre las divisas. "En la reciente cumbre entre Japón y Estados Unidos, el presidente Trump expresó su preocupación por la debilidad del yen", declaró Katayama en una rueda de prensa habitual, y añadió que revelaba este intercambio por primera vez tras consultar con la Oficina de la Primera Ministra. El relato franco de Katayama sobre las conversaciones entre los líderes, que los gobiernos suelen mantener en secreto, apunta a una preocupación compartida en Tokio y Washington por la continua caída del yen pese a su intervención conjunta en julio. En declaraciones a la prensa más tarde en el día, Takaichi confirmó los comentarios de Trump durante su reunión, que tuvo lugar el martes en Nueva York al margen de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas. "La parte estadounidense señaló que la debilidad del yen estaba creando dificultades para su comercio, y yo respondí que, como principio general, un yen infravalorado es problemático", afirmó. No obstante, subrayó que en la cumbre no se debatió sobre política monetaria ni fiscal, y añadió que la orientación de la política económica del Gobierno de Takaichi se mantiene sin cambios. Anteriormente, Takaichi había declarado a los periodistas que ella y Trump habían mantenido una conversación "oportuna" sobre China antes de la cumbre prevista entre el mandatario estadounidense y su par chino, Xi Jinping. Katayama señaló que el debate de los líderes sobre el mercado de divisas reafirmó la postura compartida por Washington y Tokio tras su intervención coordinada del 31 de julio, incluido el compromiso de contrarrestar la volatilidad excesiva y las fluctuaciones desordenadas del yen.

item.title: Primeira-dama da China exerce “soft power” sobre público dos EUA
item.description: Ela conversou com a primeira-dama dos Estados Unidos, Melania Trump, em inglês, sem a ajuda de um tradutor, e cantou baixinho quando foi presenteada com uma serenata por um coro de jovens, exibindo um glamour natural em uma versão moderna de um traje tradicional chinês.
item.dc:creator: Claire Fu, Ben Blanchard
item.content:encoded: Ela conversou com a primeira-dama dos Estados Unidos, Melania Trump, em inglês, sem a ajuda de um tradutor, e cantou baixinho quando foi presenteada com uma serenata por um coro de jovens, exibindo um glamour natural em uma versão moderna de um traje tradicional chinês. Na viagem do presidente da China, Xi Jinping, a Washington, sua esposa, Peng Liyuan, é sua superarma de “soft power”, projetando uma imagem mais gentil e acessível da China, apesar das disputas com os Estados Unidos sobre tudo, desde o comércio até Taiwan. “Obrigado, mãe Peng!”, disseram as crianças do coro a ela, após apresentarem a canção folclórica chinesa “Flor de Jasmim” no Museu Nacional de Arte Asiática do Smithsonian, em Washington, na quinta-feira. O embaixador da China em Washington, Xie Feng, destacou o papel diplomático dela no X, postando um vídeo de Peng aplaudindo a apresentação. Peng “incentivou os adolescentes norte-americanos a continuarem estudando a língua e a cultura chinesas e a se tornarem embaixadores da amizade entre a China e os Estados Unidos”, escreveu Xie. “Ela ajuda a dar um tom mais humano ao que, de outra forma, poderia ser uma diplomacia bastante rígida, e a criar momentos agradáveis no que diz respeito às relações entre os EUA e a China”, disse Joe Mazur, analista de geopolítica da consultoria Trivium China, com sede em Pequim. O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China não respondeu a um pedido de comentário sobre a recepção a Peng em Washington. No entanto, as discussões nas redes sociais chinesas sobre suas atividades e escolhas de moda durante a viagem continuam bastante limitadas, o que ressalta a sensibilidade em relação à discussão pública sobre a vida pessoal dos principais líderes do país. Pesquisas sobre seu estilo de moda e suas habilidades em inglês na popular plataforma chinesa Red Note não geraram resultados. As esposas dos principais líderes chineses têm, tradicionalmente, mantido um perfil discreto nas últimas décadas, devido à experiência de Jiang Qing, viúva do fundador da China comunista, Mao Zedong. Jiang, líder da infame “Gangue dos Quatro” que exerceu poder supremo durante a Revolução Cultural, de 1966 a 1976, recebeu uma sentença de morte suspensa em 1981 pelas mortes de dezenas de milhares de pessoas durante aquele período de caos. Peng era anteriormente mais conhecida na China como soprano do Exército. À medida que Xi ascendia ao poder no início dos anos 2000, a mídia chinesa passou a ter mais liberdade para cobrir as atividades dela. “Quando ele chega em casa, nunca pensei nisso como se houvesse algum líder na casa. Aos meus olhos, ele é apenas meu marido”, disse Peng em uma entrevista a uma revista estatal em 2007. Ela descreveu Xi como frugal, trabalhador e com os pés no chão. De origem humilde, Peng tem defendido causas sociais complexas, como a das pessoas que vivem com HIV/AIDS. Peng é a segunda esposa de Xi, e os dois têm uma filha que estudou em Harvard. Xi se divorciou de sua primeira esposa, filha de um diplomata. (Reportagem de Claire Fu e Ben Blanchard; Reportagem adicional de Mei Mei Chu)

item.title: Sri Lanka's parliament approves constitutional amendment to extend judge terms
item.description: Sri Lanka's parliament approved an amendment to the island nation's constitution on Friday to extend superior court judges' tenure by two years as part of measures to clear a large backlog of cases and reduce prisoner numbers after deadly prison riots.
item.dc:creator: Uditha Jayasinghe
item.content:encoded: Sri Lanka's parliament approved an amendment to the island nation's constitution on Friday to extend superior court judges' tenure by two years as part of measures to clear a large backlog of cases and reduce prisoner numbers after deadly prison riots. Delayed proceedings, which often drag on for years, have fuelled a crisis across Sri Lanka's prison network, where 22 facilities built for about 11,000 inmates now hold more than 41,000 — including thousands of remand prisoners yet to be tried. The move follows two recent prison riots that killed [USN:L4N43C0GA TEXT:"31 people"], including 10 prison officials, and injured dozens more. The amendment seeks to reduce a backlog of an estimated 1.1 million court cases, according to the country's justice ministry. The 22nd amendment to Sri Lanka's constitution was approved with a two-thirds majority by the 225-member house. The constitutional amendment will extend the tenure of Supreme Court, Appeals Court and High Court judges and of the Chief Justice by two years each. A separate draft bill to extend the tenure of district and magistrate judges by two years was approved as well. Bimal Rathnayake, Leader of the House, told lawmakers ahead of the vote: "This constitutional amendment is purely to support judicial reforms. This is why there isn't any significant protest from the masses." Sri Lanka's main opposition, the Samagi Jana Balawegaya, wore black to parliament and protested the amendment, contending that it undermined judicial independence.

item.title: Monedas caen y perfilan semana de descensos ante expectativas alzas tasas Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina caían el viernes y se encaminaban a acumular bajas semanales, en medio de las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina caían el viernes y se encaminaban a acumular bajas semanales, en medio de las expectativas de nuevas alzas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal. * Pese a que el dólar descendía en la jornada, junto con los precios del petróleo, el billete verde marchaba hacia su segunda ganancia semanal consecutiva, ante el reajuste de los mercados de las perspectivas sobre alzas de tasas por parte de la Fed, debido principalmente al avance de los precios de la energía. * "Parte de esta corrección a la baja del dólar está explicada por un retroceso de los precios de energéticos, lo que modera el riesgo de presiones inflacionarias globales", dijo Banco Base en un reporte. * Los precios del crudo descendían en la sesión ante expectativas de que Estados Unidos e Irán puedan lograr un acuerdo que reabra el estrecho de Ormuz. * Mientras, varias autoridades monetarias de la Fed han expresado su disposición a aumentar el costo del crédito más adelante si las presiones sobre los precios no remiten de la forma esperada. En la sesión, además, los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro subían nuevamente, amortiguando el descenso del dólar. * El peso mexicano bajaba un ligero 0,04%, a 17,7252 unidades por dólar, en su cuarta sesión de descensos y encaminándose a su peor semana desde marzo; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, subía un 0,59%, a 64.640,88 puntos, apuntando a un alza semanal. * El real brasileño cedía un 0,29% a 5,2077 por dólar, mientras que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) perdía un 0,85%, a 182,407 puntos, presionada por las acciones de Petrobras ante la baja de los precios del petróleo y la nueva alza de los retornos de los bonos estadounidenses. * Los mercados de Brasil seguían pendientes también de las elecciones presidenciales locales de inicios de octubre. * Un sondeo de Datafolha divulgado la noche del jueves mostró al presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva 2 puntos por sobre su rival de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro, en una hipotética segunda vuelta, aunque la diferencia se encuentra dentro del margen de error de la muestra, por lo que ambos se encuentran prácticamente empatados. * El peso chileno , bajaba un 0,75%, a 966,20/966,50 unidades por dólar, mientras que el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) retrocedía un 0,17%, a 11.278,13 puntos. * Mientras, el peso colombiano se recuperaba un 0,79% a 3.323 unidades por dólar, tras una seguidilla de nueves jornadas de pérdidas; mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) retrocedía un 0,98% a 2.583,73 puntos. * El peso argentino interbancario se depreciaba un 0,23% a 1.523,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, con regulación de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA). Mientras que el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires moderaba sus pérdidas de más un 1% más temprano y retrocedía un 0,57%, tras acumular hasta el jueves una caída de 3,97% en cinco rondas seguidas. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreciaba un 0,06% a 3,4120/3,4180 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) avanzaba un 0,31% a 1.581,83 puntos.

item.title: Preço mais alto da energia desafia atratividade do mercado livre no Brasil
item.description: Preços mais altos de energia elétrica no Brasil diminuíram a economia potencial para consumidores que queiram aderir ao mercado livre, um cenário que tende a permanecer e pode pesar sobre a atratividade do segmento no processo de liberalização a todos os consumidores do país, a partir do fim de 2027 e 2028, de acordo com empresas do ramo.
item.dc:creator: Leticia Augusto
item.content:encoded: Preços mais altos de energia elétrica no Brasil diminuíram a economia potencial para consumidores que queiram aderir ao mercado livre, um cenário que tende a permanecer e pode pesar sobre a atratividade do segmento no processo de liberalização a todos os consumidores do país, a partir do fim de 2027 e 2028, de acordo com empresas do ramo. As comercializadoras de energia ainda apostam em crescimento do mercado, que passará da casa dos milhares para milhões de consumidores nos próximos anos, mas apontam que o fator "preço" pode reduzir a velocidade das adesões, a exemplo do que já acontece com os clientes aptos ao mercado livre. Os descontos ofertados para entrada no mercado livre de energia, que há três anos podiam chegar a 40% frente aos preços do mercado regulado, atendidos pelas distribuidoras, hoje estão em menos de 10%, apontam executivos do setor. "Lá em 2023 a gente conseguia fazer contratos de R$100 a R$150 o megawatt-hora. Hoje, para 2027, ele gira em torno da faixa de R$300", disse Maikon Del Ré Perin, especialista em risco e inteligência de mercado da Ludfor, que também atua com comercialização varejista. A [USN:L1N41O0TQ TEXT:"disparada dos preços de energia"] veio desde 2025, sobretudo após ajustes nos modelos de precificação que tornaram o sistema brasileiro mais avesso a risco. Em paralelo, o fim de um desconto a energias renováveis no uso das redes também aumentou os custos dessas fontes, impactando os valores cobrados em novos contratos entre comercializadoras e consumidores. O "varejo" elétrico, composto por pequenas e médias empresas, cresceu aceleradamente depois da eliminação, em 2024, de barreiras para adesão ao mercado livre. Mas boa parte do mercado potencial já se esgotou, fazendo com que as migrações recuassem 34% de janeiro a julho deste ano ante igual período de 2025, segundo dados da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE). Ainda segundo Perin, os descontos possíveis para 2027 frente ao mercado regulado estão entre 5% e 10%, contra 40% há alguns anos. Ele pondera, no entanto, que esse cenário pode mudar para melhor, principalmente se as chuvas forem favoráveis à geração hidrelétrica -- a hidrologia é um fator relevante para os preços de energia no Brasil. Comercializadoras com presença relevante no segmento, como Matrix e Echoenergia, estão procurando focar na manutenção de sua carteira de clientes neste ano, em vez de expandi-la, enquanto se preparam para as próximas ondas de abertura de mercado. "O custo de aquisição do cliente é relativamente alto e agora o desconto que você consegue dar para esse cliente é pequeno. Então, diminuiu a atividade e diminuiu também a intensidade com a qual a gente atende a esse mercado", disse à Reuters Liu Aquino, CEO da geradora renovável e comercializadora Echoenergia, do grupo Equatorial (EQTL3.SA) . A Matrix, que detém a terceira maior carteira entre as comercializadoras varejistas do país, "estabilizou suas operações", diante do cenário desafiador de preços e de uma inadimplência mais elevada, afirmou Alexandre Gomes, vice-presidente comercial. Mas a companhia mantém a comercialização varejista como uma prioridade, enquanto se reestrutura e se desfaz de outros negócios, como ativos de geração distribuída solar, disse ele. "De fato, é a manutenção (da carteira), é levando uma experiência cada vez melhor para esse nosso cliente... que a gente entende que consegue replicar e ganhar escala, obviamente, dependendo das condições econômicas de abertura de mercado." Para Gomes, o preço não será o único recurso das comercializadoras para ganhar novos clientes. A Matrix, por exemplo, tem ofertado soluções agregadas, como baterias, a clientes como supermercados, que conseguem melhorar suas operações a partir da instalação desses equipamentos, apontou. O segmento varejista do setor elétrico abrange hoje cerca de 50 mil unidades consumidoras, respondendo por um volume de energia ainda pequeno diante de todo o mercado livre, que abriga também os grandes consumidores industriais. Mas esse quadro deve mudar a partir de novembro de 2027, com a autorização dada pelo governo brasileiro para migração de mais um grupo de estabelecimentos ligados em baixa tensão, como hospitais, escolas e outros, somando cerca de 6 milhões de consumidores. Já a partir de novembro de 2028, todos os 90 milhões de consumidores do país, incluindo residências, poderão escolher livremente seu fornecedor de energia. A mudança para o mercado livre não é obrigatória, de modo que o consumidor poderá continuar comprando energia de sua distribuidora local. Agentes do setor elétrico têm evitado fazer projeções sobre a velocidade das migrações a partir de 2027, apontando um elevado grau de incerteza.

item.title: Russia's Perm oil refinery halted operations after Friday drone attack, sources say
item.description: The Perm oil refinery, Russia's seventh-largest oil processing plant by volume, stopped operations following a Ukrainian drone attack, which caused a fire and damaged pipelines, storage and technological units on Friday, two industry sources said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Perm oil refinery, Russia's seventh-largest oil processing plant by volume, stopped operations following a Ukrainian drone attack, which caused a fire and damaged pipelines, storage and technological units on Friday, two industry sources said. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday he had discussed with US President Donald Trump efforts to end the four-year-old war with Russia, including a potential bilateral ceasefire on energy-related targets. Governor of Perm region, Dmitry Makhonin, said on his Telegram channel that an industrial site had came under attack on Friday, but did not name the plant. Lukoil, the refinery's owner, did not reply to a request for comment. The refinery was previously attacked on August 21. The plant, located 1,460 km (907 miles) northeast of Moscow, processed some 12.6 million tons, or 252,000 barrels per day, of oil in 2024. It produced 2 million tons of gasoline, 5.3 million tons of diesel, 200,000 tons of fuel oil and 700,000 tons of petroleum coke.

item.title: Votação da União Europeia sobre sistema de direção FSD da Tesla é adiada
item.description: A votação pela União Europeia sobre a autorização do sistema Full Self-Driving (FSD) supervisionado da Tesla em todo o bloco, prevista para outubro, foi adiada, e a próxima oportunidade para uma decisão não ocorrerá antes de dezembro, de acordo com uma agenda publicada no site da UE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A votação pela União Europeia sobre a autorização do sistema Full Self-Driving (FSD) supervisionado da Tesla em todo o bloco, prevista para outubro, foi adiada, e a próxima oportunidade para uma decisão não ocorrerá antes de dezembro, de acordo com uma agenda publicada no site da UE. O órgão regulador holandês RDW aprovou o sistema em abril, com a Bélgica e alguns outros países seguindo o exemplo. O RDW também está propondo que o software de direção autônoma seja aprovado em todo o bloco. Já a Tesla informou em 1º de setembro, em uma postagem no X, que uma votação em toda a UE poderia ocorrer em 6 de outubro. No entanto, a pauta da reunião de 6 de outubro do Comitê Técnico de Veículos Motorizados (TCMV, na sigla em inglês), que reúne representantes dos Estados-membros da UE e da Comissão Europeia, lista apenas uma “continuação das discussões” sobre o pedido holandês de autorização nos termos do Artigo 39, com 25 minutos alocados para a discussão. O comitê já discutiu o pedido da Tesla em duas reuniões anteriores. A próxima reunião agendada do TCMV após outubro é em dezembro, o que torna essa a primeira oportunidade para uma votação com base na agenda atual. A implantação em toda a UE requer o apoio de uma “maioria qualificada” de 15 dos 27 Estados-membros do bloco, representando 65% da população. Vários países da UE, incluindo a Suécia, expressaram preocupações quanto ao FSD exceder os limites de velocidade, enquanto os países que o aprovaram afirmam que os motoristas continuam responsáveis pelo cumprimento das leis de trânsito. O mesmo comitê aprovou o sistema de assistência ao motorista BlueCruise da Ford (F.N) em março de 2024, tendo a Alemanha como patrocinadora. A Tesla considera a aprovação do FSD fundamental para impulsionar as vendas na Europa, onde busca recuperar participação de mercado em meio à crescente concorrência dos fabricantes chineses de veículos elétricos.

item.title: US appeals court upholds Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic
item.description: A federal appeals court on Friday declined to block a Defense Department order blacklisting Anthropic from military contracts and deeming the AI startup a national security risk.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A federal appeals court on Friday declined to block a Defense Department order [USN:L6N3ZT1EV TEXT:"blacklisting Anthropic"] from military contracts and deeming the AI startup a national security risk. The ruling from the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit came in a lawsuit by Anthropic challenging its designation by the Pentagon as a national security supply chain risk, which the startup says has cost it billions of dollars in lost business and damaged its reputation ahead of a [USN:L4N4291D9 TEXT:"highly anticipated initial public offering"]. Anthropic said in a statement that it respectfully disagrees with the decision but remains confident in its position and is considering its options, including further judicial review. A federal judge in San Francisco last month [USN:L6N40C0YN TEXT:"struck down a parallel designation"] under a different law, finding the administration had unlawfully retaliated against Anthropic for its views on AI safety.

item.title: Eli Lilly owes Nektar $90 mln in drug collaboration dispute, US jury says
item.description: A federal jury in California has determined that Eli Lilly must pay Nektar Therapeutics $90 million for breaking an agreement related to an autoimmune drug candidate that the companies developed together, according to a Nektar filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: A federal jury in California has determined that Eli Lilly (LLY.N) must pay Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR.O) $90 million for breaking an agreement related to an autoimmune drug candidate that the companies developed together, according to a Nektar filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. The jury on Thursday agreed with Nektar that Lilly breached its duty of good faith by undermining the prospects for Rezpeg, developed to treat eczema, psoriasis and other conditions, after buying competitor Dermira. A Lilly spokesperson said in a statement on Friday that the jury "confirmed that Lilly used commercially reasonable efforts to develop Rezpeg as required by the contract and awarded only a small fraction of the damages Nektar sought." Nektar had requested $1 billion in damages, according to court filings. "We are very pleased with the jury’s verdict, finding that Eli Lilly, the largest pharmaceutical company in the world, breached its obligation to act in good faith," Nektar's lead attorney Diane Doolittle of Quinn Emanuel said in a statement. Nektar [USN:L1N39O17M TEXT:"said in the complaint"], filed in 2023, that Lilly purposely "botched" its analysis of their drug trials to make Rezpeg appear less effective and give it a pretext to terminate their agreement Lilly denied the allegations and said in a court filing that Rezpeg "did not yield acceptable clinical trial results according to the standards that Nektar and Lilly jointly developed and agreed to." The case is Nektar Therapeutics v. Eli Lilly & Co, US District Court for the Northern District of California, No. 3:23-cv-03943. For Nektar: Diane Doolittle of Quinn Emanuel Urquhart & Sullivan For Lilly: Ryan Moorman of Kirkland & Ellis Read more: [USN:L1N39O17M TEXT:"Nektar Therapeutics sues Eli Lilly over autoimmune disease treatment"]

item.title: China y EEUU se interesan por proyectos mineros en Perú mientras gobierno urge elevar producción
item.description: Perú espera elevar su producción anual de cobre en un millón de toneladas en cinco a seis años con nuevos proyectos, mientras empresas chinas y estadounidenses evalúan inversiones en medio de una mayor competencia por minerales críticos en Sudamérica, dijo a Reuters el ministro de Energía y Minas, Guillermo Shinno.
item.dc:creator: Marco Aquino
item.content:encoded: Perú espera elevar su producción anual de cobre en un millón de toneladas en cinco a seis años con nuevos proyectos, mientras empresas chinas y estadounidenses evalúan inversiones en medio de una mayor competencia por minerales críticos en Sudamérica, dijo a Reuters el ministro de Energía y Minas, Guillermo Shinno. El país andino, el tercer mayor productor mundial de cobre, espera que su producción se mantenga este año en entre 2,5 y 2,7 millones de toneladas, prácticamente sin cambios desde el 2023 por la disminución de la ley del mineral, y en medio de recurrentes conflictos sociales, dijo el titular de la cartera. Shinno señaló que el gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, que asumio a fines de julio, busca revertir este estancamiento simplificando los trámites burocráticos. En los últimos dos meses una veintena de empresas mineras han mostrado interés en desempolvar proyectos, dijo. Entre ellas de China, que compra el 73% del cobre que produce Perú; y de Estados Unidos, en momentos en que Washington busca expandir su presencia en las cadenas de suministro de minerales críticos. "Las expectativas son enormes, todos han estado preguntando y viniendo al ministerio para ver cómo pueden implementar sus proyectos", afirmó Shinno en una entrevista la noche del jueves. El ministro dijo que el Gobierno está comprometido en reducir el centenar de trámites en el sector, para atraer inversión. "Se ha identificado que podríamos eliminar 27 permisos", dijo Shinno. "No se trata de relajar el estándar ambiental, sino ser rigurosos y muy claros". Alrededor del 70% de los 64.000 millones de dólares de la cartera de proyectos mineros está vinculado al cobre, agregó. El ministro señaló que casi toda la inversión comprometida para este año, que sumarían unos 7.000 millones de dólares, son solo para fortalecer operaciones o para extender la vida de las minas. "Con nuevos proyectos previstos, en 5 o 6 años podríamos agregar un millón de toneladas de cobre mas por año", dijo. La minería es clave para la economía local porque sus ventas representan el 70% de las exportaciones totales del país. POTENCIALES PLANES Entre las firmas que se han acercado al despacho de Shinno, según registros del ministerio, figuran las chinas Las Bambas de MMG, Chinalco, Shougang y Jinzhao; las estadounidenses Newmont (NEM.N) y Freeport-McMoRan (FCX.N) , además de las globales First Quantum (FM.TO) , Barrick (ABX.TO) , Anglo American (AAL.L) y Glencore (GLEN.L) . El ministro dijo que First Quantum quiere avanzar con su proyecto de cobre La Granja, mientras que Chinalco adquirió en julio el proyecto Los Calatos, en el sur del país, y actualmente está realizando estudios ambientales previos a su desarrollo. First Quantum informó en un comunicado en mayo que actualizó los recursos en La Granja y describió al proyecto "como el segundo mayor recurso de cobre virgen del mundo". El Gobierno estima inversiones de 2.400 millones de dólares en La Granja y 655 millones de dólares en Los Calatos en los próximos años. Chinalco, que opera la mina Toromocho, y Las Bambas están entre las seis minas de cobre más grandes del Perú. Shinno afirmó que prevé asimismo una mayor inversión minera estadounidense mientras Washington busca reducir la influencia china en los minerales estratégicos. Estados Unidos y Perú firmaron en febrero un acuerdo de cooperación en minerales críticos, que el secretario de Estado estadounidense, Marco Rubio, destacó durante su visita a Lima en septiembre como una forma de aprovechar las nuevas oportunidades en el sector. "Todos aquellos que quieren invertir responsablemente y respetar las leyes peruanas son bienvenidos. No hay un trato discriminatorio. Esperemos que con esta nueva política que tiene Estados Unidos más empresas americanas se animen a venir", dijo Shinno. La estadounidense Freeport-McMoRan planea extender hasta el 2053 la vida de su mina de cobre en Perú, con una inversión de 2.100 millones de dólares, según el ministerio peruano.

item.title: Chinese, US firms line up for Peru copper projects as government cuts red tape
item.description: Peru expects to boost annual copper production by about 1 million metric tons within 5 to 6 years through new mining projects, as Chinese and US companies weigh investments amid broader competition for critical minerals in South America, Peru's Energy and Mines Minister told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Marco Aquino
item.content:encoded: Peru expects to boost annual copper production by about 1 million metric tons within 5 to 6 years through new [USN:L6N43H166 TEXT:"mining projects"], as Chinese and US companies weigh investments amid broader competition for critical minerals in South America, Peru's Energy and Mines Minister told Reuters. Peru, the world's third-largest copper producer, expects output to remain between 2.5 million and 2.7 million tons this year, roughly unchanged from 2023 due to declining ore grades and recurring social conflicts, Minister Guillermo Shinno said. The newly elected conservative government of [USN:L6N43Q0ZQ TEXT:"President Keiko Fujimori"] is seeking to reverse that [USN:L1N3WU0PV TEXT:"stagnation"] by cutting red tape. In the two months since the Fujimori administration took office, mining companies have stepped up engagement with the ministry as they seek to revive stalled projects, Shinno said. Companies including from China , Peru's largest copper customer, and from the US as [USN:S0N42V05J TEXT:"Washington"] seeks to expand its footprint in critical mineral supply chains, have expressed interest. "Expectations are enormous. Everyone has been asking questions and coming to the ministry to see how they can move forward with their projects," Shinno said in an interview with Reuters late on Thursday. CUTTING BACK SOME REQUIREMENTS The minister said the government was committed to reducing roughly 100 permitting requirements across the mining sector to attract investment. "We have identified 27 permits that could be eliminated," the minister said. "This is not about lowering environmental standards, but about being rigorous and very clear." About 70% of Peru's $64 billion mining project pipeline is tied to copper, Shinno added. Most of the roughly $7 billion in mining investment expected in 2026 is aimed at sustaining operations or extending mine life, rather than adding significant new output. "With the new projects we have planned, in five or six years we could add another million tons of copper production per year," Shinno said. CHINESE, US FIRMS EYE PROJECTS Among roughly 20 companies that have met with the new administration are Chinese firms such as MMG (1208.HK) , which owns [USN:L6N44G16H TEXT:"Las Bambas"], Chinalco, Shougang and Jinzhao, US-based miners Newmont (NEM.N) and Freeport-McMoRan FCX.N and global mining companies First Quantum (FM.TO) , Barrick (ABX.TO) , Anglo American (AAL.L) and Glencore (GLEN.L) , ministry records show. Shinno said First Quantum wants to advance its La Granja copper project, while Chinalco in July acquired the Los Calatos project in southern Peru, which is undergoing environmental studies ahead of development. First Quantum representatives in Lima did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The government estimates investments of $2.4 billion for La Granja and $655 million for Los Calatos in the coming years. The Toromocho mine, operated by [USN:L1N3YU1NA TEXT:"Chinalco"], and Las Bambas are among Peru's 6 largest copper mines. Shinno said he also expects greater US mining investment as Washington seeks to counter Chinese influence in strategic minerals. The US and Peru signed a critical minerals cooperation agreement in February, which US Secretary of State Marco Rubio highlighted during a [USN:L1N4520UP TEXT:"visit to Peru"] this month as a way to capitalize on new opportunities in the sector. "We hope that more American companies will be encouraged to come," Shinno added.

item.title: Data centre IPO hopefuls brave tougher market as investor scrutiny grows
item.description: Data centre operator DayOne is pushing ahead with its plans to go public as soon as November, according to three people familiar with the matter, even as higher interest rates and setbacks elsewhere ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Data centre operator DayOne is pushing ahead with its plans to go public as soon as November, according to three people familiar with the matter, even as higher interest rates and setbacks elsewhere in the data centre ecosystem threaten to narrow the window for companies to tap the IPO market. The Singapore-based company develops and operates data centres for cloud and AI customers. It plans to make its filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission public in mid-October and list in November, the people said, speaking anonymously to discuss confidential matters. The plans, including the timing of the IPO, are subject to change, the people cautioned. DayOne declined to comment. DayOne’s IPO intentions follow two setbacks for data centre operators this week: the delay of SB Energy’s expected IPO and news of a dispute centering on Oracle and Blue Owl that could delay a data centre project in New Mexico. The contrast highlights how the market for AI infrastructure is maturing after years of strong investor enthusiasm. Companies with diversified customers and greater visibility into demand can still attract interest, while projects that rely heavily on a single AI customer or require large amounts of capital upfront face greater scrutiny. “The dividing line is whether demand is contracted and already energized, or only planned,” said Ke Yan, head of research at Singapore-based investment research firm Shenton Research. With power now the key constraint, investors favor operators with secured power supply, a large share of contracted capacity already operating or nearing completion, and long-dated take-or-pay contracts, he said. Investor scrutiny is intensifying as a growing pipeline of companies head toward the public markets, with data centre developers and operators including Switch, Vantage Data Centers and CyrusOne exploring or preparing IPOs. Switch has filed confidentially for an IPO, and is expected to launch its offering following DayOne, one of the people said. Switch did not respond to a request for comments. A more diversified offering DayOne’s geographic diversification and the fact it has operational data centers, not just ones under development, have helped distinguish it from some rivals in the eyes of investors, one of the people said. The company, backed by investors like Coatue and Hillhouse, raised US$4.5 billion in a Series C funding round that closed in June. It could seek to raise as much as $5 billion in the IPO at a valuation of about $20 billion, Reuters has reported. It has secured about 2.1 gigawatts of capacity bookings and operates across Asia-Pacific and Europe, including Malaysia, Hong Kong, Japan, Finland and Spain, according to its website. Meanwhile, SoftBank-backed SB Energy has postponed plans to formally market its IPO this week as it works to address additional questions from the US Securities and Exchange Commission. There are also investor concerns over the valuation it is seeking and its reliance on OpenAI as a major customer, one of the three people familiar with the matter and another person said. Discussions around the IPO have centered on a valuation of about $60 billion, one of the people added. SB Energy declined to comment. There have been various dealings between SoftBank, SB Energy, its main data centre customer OpenAI and OpenAI’s chip supplier Nvidia in recent months. Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $105 billion to help OpenAI lease the Ohio data centre being developed by SB Energy, while also investing $1.5 billion in SB Energy. OpenAI backer SoftBank is taking investor orders for a $10 billion dollar-denominated debt deal to help fund its OpenAI investments. The company previously took a loan backed by the OpenAI stake. AI spending faces closer scrutiny The cost of financing the AI buildout is coming under greater pressure. AI-related capital spending by the six biggest U.S. technology companies is projected to reach around $1 trillion in 2027, according to Moody’s. Higher interest rates make it more expensive to finance facilities whose returns may take years to materialize, while investors are demanding greater visibility into the customers and cash flows that will support those investments. For developers relying on debt, contracted revenue from creditworthy customers is crucial to servicing that debt as they fund costly AI-ready facilities, including high-density racks and liquid-cooling systems, said Neil Bear-Hetherington, director of data centre capital markets, Asia Pacific, at CBRE. For data centre developers, that makes the identity and financial strength of their customers increasingly important to investors evaluating projects that can require billions of dollars of upfront investment. For companies preparing to go public, a less forgiving IPO market and greater scrutiny of AI infrastructure create an incentive to move quickly while investor demand is available. “The earlier the better. Uncertainty is what hurts data-centre models. Investors in data centres are looking for yield and growth together, and uncertainty weighs on both, since it raises the cost of the debt that supports the yield and delays the grid and financing that growth depends on,” said Yan of Shenton Research. (Reporting by Echo Wang in New York and Yantoultra Ngui in Hong Kong; Additional reporting by Milana Vinn in New York and Kane Wu in Hong Kong; Editing by Colin Barr and Nia Williams)

item.title: Russia says it struck Ukrainian defence industry facilities, vessels
item.description: The Russian defence ministry said on Friday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on Ukrainian defence industry facilities, logistics centres and vessels used by Ukraine's armed forces.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Russian defence ministry said on Friday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on Ukrainian defence industry facilities, logistics centres and vessels used by Ukraine's armed forces. The ministry said the strikes hit a drone assembly and storage site in the Kyiv region, logistics hubs in the Odesa region and port infrastructure in Reni on the Danube River. It also said Russian forces struck a cargo ship carrying military and dual-use goods to the port of Odesa. The ministry said later on Friday that its forces had struck another cargo vessel in the Odesa region that delivered military supplies to the port of Chornomorsk, a logistics centre used by Ukraine's military and security forces, and a data centre used for processing and transmission of intelligence data. Reuters could not independently verify the statements.

item.title: US Senate approves legislation to address pilot, air traffic control mental health issues
item.description: The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation to modernize regulations on mental health guidance for pilots and air traffic controllers to encourage early disclosure and treatment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation to modernize regulations on mental health guidance for pilots and air traffic controllers to encourage early disclosure and treatment. Commercial airline pilots often conceal mental health conditions for fear that disclosing therapy or medication, or even just seeking help, could mean having their license pulled, putting themselves and their passengers at risk. The issue drew new attention after an off-duty Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) pilot in late 2023 was charged with trying to disable the engines of a jet in flight and told police afterward he was suffering a nervous breakdown. The legislation, sponsored by Senators John Hoeven and Tammy Duckworth, was approved unanimously late Thursday and aims to encourage pilots and air traffic controllers to seek mental health care, when needed, while reducing the stigma. A separate bill also passed by the Senate requires the FAA to issue accessible, user-friendly guidance on approved medications to ensure pilots or controllers these individuals don't unknowingly take medications that could put their careers in jeopardy. "Their careers should never be threatened because they weren't properly informed about which medications they're allowed to take, or simply sought the mental health care they need," said Duckworth, a Democrat, adding lawmakers aim to "dismantle the dangerous culture of silence surrounding mental health in the aviation industry and ultimately make our skies safer." Pilots face strict rules around medication and can be forced to stop flying for three months if they change antidepressant or anxiety drug dosage levels or medications for mental health issues. Hoeven, a Republican, noted the significant shortage of qualified pilots and air traffic controllers, adding "bureaucratic delays and outdated processes at the FAA keep these professionals from working for prolonged periods when they seek mental health care." The Allied Pilots Association, which represents 17,000 pilots at American Airlines (AAL.O) , praised passage of the bills saying they represent meaningful progress toward modernizing the FAA’s approach to pilot mental health. "For far too long, pilots have faced barriers to seeking care and navigating the medical certification process," APA President Nick Silva said. The FAA which did not immediately comment Friday, convened an expert panel in late 2023 to make recommendations on pilot mental health issues and "to help break down barriers that prevent pilots and air traffic controllers from reporting mental health issues." The report found that about 20% of pilots and controllers who report a mental health issue are initially disqualified from work and it can take more than a year to get approval to use an antidepressant medication.

item.title: Na França, papa Leão 14 alerta que ONU corre risco de se tornar uma “farsa”
item.description: O papa Leão 14 afirmou na sexta-feira que as Nações Unidas e outros organismos multilaterais estão em crise, alertando, em um discurso na sede da Unesco, órgão da ONU para a cultura e a educação, em Paris, que o diálogo internacional corre o risco de se tornar uma “farsa”.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee, Elizabeth Pineau
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão 14 afirmou na sexta-feira que as Nações Unidas e outros organismos multilaterais estão em crise, alertando, em um discurso na sede da Unesco, órgão da ONU para a cultura e a educação, em Paris, que o diálogo internacional corre o risco de se tornar uma “farsa”. O primeiro papa norte-americano, falando durante uma visita à França enquanto uma tensa Assembleia Geral da ONU se desenrola em Nova York, também criticou os líderes mundiais que desrespeitam o Estado de Direito, sem citar nomes. “Em vez de respeitar a lei, aqueles que estão no poder a invocam quando lhes convém e a desconsideram quando lhes impõe restrições, tratando até mesmo a própria justiça como se fosse uma mercadoria a ser comprada e vendida”, disse o pontífice. A ONU e outros grupos multilaterais “estão passando por uma crise de eficácia”, afirmou ele. “O diálogo é visto como um obstáculo à ação, em vez de um recurso para a paz; uma farsa, em vez de uma oportunidade de buscar juntos o bem comum.” Leão, que se tornou papa em maio de 2025, despertou a ira do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, no início do ano, após criticar a guerra contra o Irã. A Assembleia Geral da ONU deste ano, que termina na segunda-feira, tem sido palco de discussões acaloradas. Em um discurso na terça-feira, Trump ameaçou aniquilar o Irã caso o país não concorde com os termos para encerrar a guerra. Na quinta-feira, dezenas de delegados deixaram o plenário enquanto o primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, discursava. Trump anunciou em 2025 que os EUA se retirariam da Unesco. Leão está em uma visita a três cidades da França, onde busca restaurar a reputação da Igreja após escândalos de abuso que causaram comoção em todo o país. PAPA ALERTA PARA RISCOS DA IA O papa, que fez do alerta sobre os riscos da IA uma parte central de seu papado de 16 meses, colocou a questão no centro de sua visita à França, a primeira de um papa em quase 20 anos. Na manhã desta sexta-feira, ele exortou o mundo a reconsiderar o desenvolvimento da inteligência artificial, alertando em um discurso aos líderes franceses que a IA poderia criar um futuro em que “um paraíso das máquinas” assumisse o controle da Terra. “Se quisermos evitar perder nossa humanidade em meio a um ‘paraíso das máquinas’ que invade e condiciona nossa vida cotidiana, há uma necessidade urgente de educação em discernimento ético”, disse ele, falando sob os tetos dourados do Palácio do Eliseu. MENSAGEM DE PAZ Leão foi recebido no aeroporto de Orly, em Paris, sob um céu azul límpido, pelo presidente Emmanuel Macron e sua esposa Brigitte, além de crianças que cantaram para ele e pediram autógrafos. Durante sua visita de quatro dias, ele viajará ao famoso santuário católico de Lourdes, no sudoeste, e a Metz, na fronteira com a Alemanha. Ao dizer aos repórteres no avião a caminho de Paris que vinha para transmitir uma mensagem de paz, Leão acrescentou: “É uma mensagem que, neste momento, como todos sabemos, é particularmente importante.” A França, uma nação secular onde a separação entre Igreja e Estado está consagrada em uma lei de 1905, tem testemunhado um declínio constante na filiação à Igreja Católica durante o período do pós-guerra, refletindo uma tendência observada em outros países tradicionalmente católicos.

item.title: La ONU amplía la lista de empresas vinculadas a los asentamientos israelíes
item.description: La Oficina de Derechos Humanos de Naciones Unidas publicó el viernes una lista en la que se añaden 61 empresas más que operan en los asentamientos israelíes de Cisjordania, que este organismo internacional considera ilegales.
item.dc:creator: Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: La Oficina de Derechos Humanos de Naciones Unidas publicó el viernes una lista en la que se añaden 61 empresas más que operan en los asentamientos israelíes de Cisjordania, que este organismo internacional considera ilegales. La base de datos es un asunto muy delicado, ya que las empresas podrían ser objeto de boicots o desinversiones para presionar a Israel por la expansión de los asentamientos en el territorio, donde viven más de tres millones de palestinos. La base de datos, publicada por primera vez en 2020, incluye ahora 214 empresas, en su mayoría de Israel, pero también de otros 10 países, entre ellos Francia, Alemania, China y Estados Unidos. Entre las empresas recién añadidas se encuentran el fabricante israelí de pesticidas ADAMA, que forma parte del grupo chino Syngenta, la sociedad de inversión inmobiliaria con sede en Israel Alony Hetz y la española Salvat Logística. Se suman así a empresas como la agencia de viajes Expedia y la plataforma de alquiler de viviendas Airbnb, que ya figuraban en la lista. Israel, que considera que Cisjordania es un territorio en disputa y no ocupado, ha afirmado anteriormente que la lista difama de forma injusta a las empresas que operan legalmente. "Se trata de un mecanismo sesgado, creado por un organismo profundamente defectuoso con una mayoría automática en contra de Israel", dijo el viernes la misión diplomática israelí, alegando que la base de datos se creó para "perseguir" al Estado judío. Se ha producido un aumento de los ataques de los colonos contra los palestinos a medida que proliferan los asentamientos, lo que ha llevado a Reino Unido, Francia y Canadá a bloquear este mes las importaciones procedentes de los asentamientos.

item.title: Prestigioso premio Goncourt de Francia retira novela tras acusaciones de uso de IA contra su autor
item.description: Los organizadores del prestigioso premio literario Goncourt anunciaron el viernes la retirada de su lista preliminar una novela de gran éxito del autor haitiano-canadiense Thelyson Orelien, tras las acusaciones de que recurrió a la inteligencia artificial para escribirla.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los organizadores del prestigioso premio literario Goncourt anunciaron el viernes la retirada de su lista preliminar una novela de gran éxito del autor haitiano-canadiense Thelyson Orelien, tras las acusaciones de que recurrió a la inteligencia artificial para escribirla. Orelien negó haber utilizado IA para escribir "C'était ça ou mourir" ("Era eso o morir"), mientras las acusaciones desencadenaban un debate sobre raza, mérito literario y originalidad que ha agitado al establishment literario francés. Las acusaciones sobre el uso de la IA las lanzó esta semana una cuenta poco conocida de la red social X llamada "Balance ton Claude". El ensayista Samuel Fitoussi reivindicó más tarde la autoría de la cuenta, afirmando que la gestionaba junto con otras personas no identificadas. A las acusaciones sobre la IA les siguieron informes que apuntaban a que Orelien había cometido plagio en obras anteriores. La Presse señaló que un relato corto de Orelien de 2012 había plagiado pasajes de un libro del autor francés Louis Pauwels, mientras que un artículo de opinión de 2013 copiaba del periódico The Philippine Star. Orelien aún no ha respondido a esas acusaciones y no contestó a una solicitud de comentarios el viernes. La Academia Goncourt, con sede en París, declaró que había tomado nota de las acusaciones de uso de IA y de plagio, y que había decidido retirar su novela "para preservar la integridad del Premio Goncourt y la de la Academia, cuya función principal es promover y honrar la literatura escrita por mujeres y hombres". La Academia afirmó que espera que su decisión muestre su total oposición a la "creación de textos generados con la ayuda de la IA" y añadió que no hará más comentarios hasta el 6 de octubre, fecha en la que anunciará su lista de finalistas. La primera novela del autor, nacido en Haití, narra la historia de un migrante haitiano que viaja hacia el norte a través de América Latina antes de llegar a Canadá. La obra ha ganado numerosos premios literarios y estaba previsto que se tradujera a varios idiomas. Sus editoriales francesa y canadiense ofrecieron inicialmente a Orelien todo su apoyo ante las acusaciones relacionadas con la IA. El viernes no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios. Balance ton Claude afirmó que al pasar fragmentos de la novela por la herramienta de detección de IA Pangram se observó que la novela 2había sido escrita casi en su totalidad por inteligencia artificial". Algunos expertos señalan que la fiabilidad de las herramientas de detección de IA es cuestionable.

item.title: Canada's budget deficit over first four months of 2026/27 slightly falls to C$5.14 billion
item.description: OTTAWA, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Canada recorded a slightly lower C$5.14 billion ($3.63 billion) budget deficit for the first four months of the 2026/27 fiscal year as government revenues grew faster than expenditures, the finance ministry said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OTTAWA, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Canada recorded a slightly lower C$5.14 billion ($3.63 billion) budget deficit for the first four months of the 2026/27 fiscal year as government revenues grew faster than expenditures, the finance ministry said on Friday. By comparison, the deficit in the same period a year earlier had been C$7.79 billion, it said in a statement. Revenues over the four-month period increased by 7.4% largely reflecting higher income from personal and corporate income tax revenues. Expenses grew by 5.1%, driven by transfers for Old Age Security, increased operating costs and other transfer payments. Public debt charges increased by 7.4%, largely reflecting higher average effective interest rates on an increased stock of marketable bonds, the ministry said. On a monthly basis, Canada's deficit increased sharply to C$4.77 billion in July, compared to a C$1.51 billion deficit in July 2025. ($1 = 1.4146 Canadian dollars) (Reporting by Promit Mukherjee, editing by David Ljunggren) ((Reuters Ottawa bureau; david.ljunggren@tr.com )) Keywords: CANADA BUDGET/

item.title: ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩエコシステムの「大きすぎてつぶせない」リスク、ＦＲＢ把握すべき＝カンザスシティー連銀総裁 0:08 配信

2023年6月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米カンザスシティー地区連銀のシュミッド総裁は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームに伴い、業界で形成されつつある企業や契約のネットワークが「大きすぎてつぶせない（too big to fail）」問題に発展していないかを米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が把握することが重要との認識を示した。

シュミッド総裁は、「ＡＩやデータセンターの構築を巡って何が起きているのかを真に包括的に理解するため、まず考えなければならないのは、『大きすぎてつぶせない』ＡＩエコシステムへ移行しつつあるのかどうかだ」と述べた。２００７─０９年の金融危機の際、主要金融機関がその規模と実体経済への影響力ゆえに公的救済を必要とした事態に言及した発言だ。

その上で「システム的なリスクは存在するのか」との問題を提起した。

item.title: US Federal Reserve plans to raise bank oversight thresholds, sources say
item.description: The US Federal Reserve is set to propose an increase in the asset thresholds for banking regulations, potentially raising the current $700 billion limit to around $960 billion. This adjustment could benefit lenders by reducing compliance costs and easing regulatory burdens for banks near the threshold. However, analysts caution that such changes may spur consolidation among mid-sized banks, which could undermine competition and elevate systemic risks in the financial sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Reserve is working on a plan to raise the asset thresholds that trigger stricter oversight of big banks, four people with knowledge of the matter said, which would allow some lenders to avoid costly additional regulation and potentially spur consolidation.The central bank is expected to soon propose reindexing the thresholds where banks become subject to stress tests of their balance sheets, liquidity, capital and other more stringent rules, to account for inflation and economic growth, the people said. Three of the people said they expect the Fed to propose the changes later this year.Current rules impose stricter requirements when a bank reaches $100 billion in assets, stepping up at $250 billion and again at $700 billion. Lenders say those thresholds, set in 2019, haven't kept pace with the economy, subjecting banks to increasingly stringent oversight that exceeds the risks they pose.Banks say crossing the $100 billion threshold typically requires major investment in compliance staff, risk management systems, stress-testing capabilities and regulatory reporting infrastructure that can run into tens of millions of dollars annually.The Fed is considering reindexing the highest threshold closer to $1 trillion and some of the requirements triggered by the lower threshold closer to $150 billion, said the people, who declined to be named as they were discussing sensitive regulatory issues.Banks that stand to benefit include U.S. Bancorp, Capital One, PNC Financial and Truist, which are closest to the $700 billion threshold, giving them more room to grow without incurring some of the toughest Fed oversight, including aspects of new incoming capital rules and daily reporting requirements to supervisors.Western Alliance, Zions and several others, meanwhile, could grow beyond $100 billion without incurring all the requirements currently imposed on lenders in that category. Pinnacle Financial Partners and one or two other lenders sitting between $100 billion and $150 billion could even shed some requirements.A Fed spokesperson declined to comment. In January, Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said the central bank would consider reindexing the thresholds and suggested using nominal GDP, but the Fed has not commented since then. The US economy has grown significantly over the past seven years, and it makes sense to have rules for all banks that will help consumers and small businesses through increased bank lending capacity and more competition, a U.S. Bancorp spokesperson said.The other banks either declined to comment or did not respond to requests for comment.CHANGES COULD SPUR MID-SIZE BANK DEALSThe plan is part of a broader effort by the Trump administration to reform bank oversight which officials say is stifling lending and the economy. Bowman is also overhauling capital rules and other aspects of the Fed's supervisory regime.The changes could lead consolidation among mid-size lenders which have been holding off for fear of breaching the thresholds, the people said. Revised thresholds can reduce downsides of growth and change relative costs/benefits of acquisitions, analysts at Truist wrote on Friday in response to Reuters' story.Banks with $50 billion to $700 billion of assets announced just 33 bank and thrift acquisitions over the past decade, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence, with just seven such deals last year, including Fifth Third's $10.9 billion acquisition of Comerica. We would expect this to unlock M&A activity among mid-cap and regional banks that have been in a holding pattern, said James Stevens, partner at law firm Troutman Pepper Locke, adding bank boards would be able to assess deals on merit rather than on the regulatory math. One banking industry executive said raising the $700 billion threshold would allow larger lenders to more effectively compete with the country's four biggest consumer banks.Critics of bank consolidation argue it harms consumers by reducing competition and services, while increasing systemic risks.BANKS HAVE LONG ARGUED THRESHOLDS ARE ARBITRARYFollowing the US financial crisis, the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act set supervisory thresholds, which Congress softened in 2018. That law mandates some requirements that only Congress can change, including stress tests for banks in the $100 billion bucket and enhanced prudential standards for those above $250 billion.But the law also gave the Fed broad discretion, and the central bank imposed additional capital planning, liquidity and reporting requirements for the $100 billion category. It also created the $700 billion category to ensure sufficient oversight for big banks not deemed globally systemically important banks, which are subject to a separate regime.Banks have long said the thresholds are arbitrary and can distort business decisions by encouraging banks to stay below them.Reindexing using nominal GDP would incorporate inflation and economic growth. It could push the highest threshold to around $960 billion and the lower threshold for the additional Fed requirements to roughly $150 billion.Democrats say Congress already watered down the rules in 2018, and asset thresholds, though imperfect, offer a simple way to calibrate requirements.

item.title: Manchester City, culpable de todos menos uno de los 115 cargos por infracciones: medios
item.description: El Manchester City fue hallado culpable de todas menos una de las 115 presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras de la Premier League, informaron el viernes The Athletic y The Times.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: El Manchester City fue hallado culpable de todas menos una de las 115 presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras de la Premier League, informaron el viernes The Athletic y The Times. Según añaden los medios, se espera que el club presente un recurso. La Premier declinó hacer declaraciones al respecto. "Se trata de un proceso confidencial, no vamos a hacer ningún comentario", indicó un portavoz. El City no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters, pero declaró a la BBC que la investigación sobre las acusaciones "sigue en curso". La Premier remitió al City a una comisión independiente en febrero de 2023 por presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras que abarcan las temporadas 2009-10 a 2022-23. El club ha negado sistemáticamente haber cometido irregularidades. Entre las acusaciones más graves estaba que el City no había facilitado en ninguna de las temporadas comprendidas entre 2009-10 y 2017-18 información financiera precisa que ofreciera una "imagen fiel" de los ingresos, incluidos los ingresos por patrocinios, y los costos operativos. El City contrató al abogado David Pannick para que dirigiera su defensa, mientras que la Premier estuvo representada por Adam Lewis KC, según los medios británicos. La vista comenzó el 16 de septiembre de 2024 y concluyó casi tres meses después, el 6 de diciembre. El caso fue juzgado por una comisión independiente compuesta por tres jueces designados por el presidente independiente del panel judicial de la Premier League. El City fue sancionado con dos años de inhabilitación para participar en la Liga de Campeones por la UEFA, el organismo rector del fútbol europeo, en 2020, tras constatarse que había sobrevalorado sus ingresos por patrocinios entre 2012 y 2016. Sin embargo, el club recurrió con éxito ante el Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo (TAS), que anuló la sanción. Desde que el Abu Dhabi United Group del jeque Mansour compró el club en 2008, el City ha ganado ocho títulos de la Premier League, la Liga de Campeones, cuatro Copas de Inglaterra y siete Copas de la Liga. El City lidera la Premier esta temporada tras ganar sus cinco primeros partidos.

item.description: WASHINGTON: The United States is expected to release details on the outcome of trade negotiations with China on Monday (Sep 28), US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday.US President Donald Trump

WASHINGTON: The United States is expected to release details on the outcome of trade negotiations with China on Monday (Sep 28), US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday. US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday but there was l ittle sign of a breakthrough on a host of sensitive issues. "We're in a managed trade situation ... we've had progress, and we will release on Monday, I think, a lot more details about what we've accomplished over the past few weeks in negotiating with the Chinese," he told CNBC. The US has agreed with China on exempting some key goods from arguments over trade, he said. The US would send agricultural products and medical devices "and we're getting from them, you know, consumer goods and other things that are non-sensitive", he added.

"We've actually reached agreement with the Chinese on a number of these things in areas where, you know if we have trade disputes in the future or if there are tariff measures in the future, we just leave those things to the side." Greer also said that the current talks did not cover a small amount of high-quality US-made chips requiring licenses. "These are the crown jewels of American technology. It's the way we stay ahead in the race for superintelligence, or AI, and so those conversations ... (are) not really happening in these negotiations," he said. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this week and said they had agreed to extend until Jan 10 a deal that paused a trade war that saw mutual tariffs top 100 per cent.

item.title: Trump sees no urgency for Canada deal as trade dispute deepens, USTR says
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration is comfortable maintaining its trade standoff with Canada even as new US import bans on Canadian products take effect next week and Washington threatens 50% tariffs on Canadian autos, parts and steel from January, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump 's administration is comfortable maintaining its trade standoff with Canada even as new US import bans on Canadian products take effect next week and Washington threatens 50% tariffs on Canadian autos, parts and steel from January, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday. His comments to CNBC signal Washington sees little need to compromise despite a deepening dispute that has strained relations between the longtime allies, triggered retaliation on both sides of the border and raised fresh questions about the future of the US-Mexico-Canada trade agreement. The looming US import bans are on a broad range of Canadian goods, including alcoholic beverages, motorcycles and dairy products. The January increase on tariffs to 50% could carry significant consequences for North American auto production. Canada's own retaliatory tariffs on US goods took effect earlier this month. Canadian tariffs followed 50% tariffs that the US imposed on some $20 billion of Canadian goods last month, after several rounds of negotiations collapsed. "We're still getting what we need from them in terms of oil, gas, potash, all of these things. We're shipping (agricultural products) back and forth across the border, so there's still a lot of strong trade between the two countries," Greer told CNBC. "We're comfortable with where we are. ... They call us now and then, and we have good conversations about potential deals. But it's not – there's no urgency on our side, I would say." The Canadian Embassy in Washington did not immediately comment. The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, who have blamed each other for the failed talks, spurred Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to urge a further shift away from Canada's biggest trading partner, and cast doubt on the viability of the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement. Some experts think the Trump administration wants to first reach a deal with Mexico, which could give the US more leverage to get a better agreement with Canada. The next round of talks with Mexico could occur in October, Mexican officials said this week.

item.content:encoded:

2026年8月26日、米国ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が２５日発表した９月の消費者信頼感指数の確報値は４８．１と、８月の５１．７から低下し、４カ月ぶりの低水準となった。インフレ加速が家計の購買力を損なうとの懸念が背景にある。ただ、速報値の４７．８からは改善した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は４７．６だった。同指数は１月から１５％低下している。現在および今後１年間の家計に対する見方はいずれも約１０％悪化し、高インフレへの懸念が引き続き強まった。消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は「全体として、年初来で経済見通しが悪化したという点で、政治的立場を超えた幅広い一致が調査から浮かび上がった」と指摘。「今月は特に大きく信頼感が落ち込んだ結果、共和党支持層の信頼感は２０２６年１月と比べ２０％低い水準にある。民主党支持層も同期間に１３％低下した」と述べた。１年後のインフレ期待は４．６％と、８月の４．０％から上昇した。イランとの紛争が始まる前の２月時点の３．４％から急上昇している。５年後のインフレ期待は３．４％と、小幅に上昇した。前月までは３カ月連続で３．３％を維持していた。

BAKU, Azerbaijan, Sept 25 : Runaway Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli called the mistake that put him out of qualifying for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "stupid" and said it had brought him back down to earth. The 20-year-old, who leads Mercedes teammate George Russell by 81 points in the overall standings after 14 rounds, clobbered the wall at the first corner in the opening phase of qualifying and had to park up with a broken suspension. He will start 16th with Russell storming to a dominant pole.   "I hit the wall and very unnecessary mistake so early on," the Italian told F1TV, explaining that he had simply misjudged the grip.

"It's a good way to come back to earth and to remind myself that I need to be on top of it every time because otherwise I do these mistakes and a very stupid one." Antonelli came into the weekend gunning for his third straight win and ninth of the season so far.  But a hydraulics issue during opening practice on Thursday cost the Italian valuable track time.  He has trailed Russell, who has looked far more at ease around the 6km Baku street track, ever since. Nevertheless, he is hoping the speed of the Mercedes can help him fight back. "I'm looking forward to tomorrow," said Antonelli, who went from 19th to first at his home Italian Grand Prix in Monza.  "Hopefully we can recover many places. "The car is quick. Hopefully tomorrow is going to be a good race."
